lines: composer.json requires packages but the app has no composer.lock, so there is nothing to audit.
composer audit reads what composer.lock pins; make build writes it.
The 319 shipped packages by licence: MIT 280, ISC 12, GPL-3.0-or-later 11, BSD-3-Clause 8, AGPL-3.0-or-later 2, BSD-2-Clause 2, (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0) 1, Apache-2.0 1, and 2 licences more.
The app is under AGPL-3.0-or-later, as appinfo/info.xml declares; licences.json held each licence against it.
The advisories were not checked (NO_ADVISORIES=1 or --no-advisories): this report says nothing about vulnerable packages.
